metadata.title: Formal Lean 4 Models and Proofs of Permutation Group Orders and Orbit-Stabilizer Algorithms for GAP (Phase 3, Release v0.3.0)
metadata.description:
Paper II (Phase 3, Release v0.3.0): Formal Lean 4 Models & Proofs of Permutation Group Orders and Orbit-Stabilizer Algorithms for GAP

Continuing our frozen Phase 1–2 baseline (Paper I, arXiv:2609.38492, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23045504) and adhering strictly to Shared Terminology Guide v2 (Rungs 0–5), this publication presents two new Lean 4 (v4.28.0 / Mathlib4) models pinned to gap-system/gap tag v4.14.0 (commit 8e68258d61fb) with 0 sorry, 0 admit, and 0 custom axioms across 30 audited theorems in RequestProject/Verify.lean (Rung 3), complemented by an open operator-level witness harness executed against an official GAP 4.12.1 binary (Rung 4a: 100/100 witnesses across 10 finite permutation groups including intransitive support-vs-storage degree embeddings and the sporadic Mathieu group M11, 0 violations, 1 synthetic negative check).

Core Contributions (Phase 3 — Sections 1 & 2)

  • GAP-0190 (lib/grpperm.gi): RequestProject.Gap.Library.Grpperm — PermGroup, support degree (LargestMovedPoint), transversal word factorization, and permGroup_order_eq_prod_basicOrbits (|G| = ∏ |Δi|).
  • GAP-0247 (lib/oprtperm.gi): RequestProject.Gap.Library.Oprtperm — onPoints, onPairs, onSets action laws & cardinality preservation, computable BFS orbitOfPoint proved equal to abstract orbitFinset, domain orbit partitioning, Orbit-Stabilizer identity |G| = |OrbG(x)| · |StabG(x)|, and transversal coset bijection.
  • Reproducible GAP 4 Harness: tools/run_rung4a_gap_witness.py and JSON evidence log docs/reports/GAP_0247_RUNG4A_WITNESS_REPORT.json.

Acknowledgments: Computational infrastructure and server resources for this work were provided by ITouch Systems (Cukurova University Technopark, Adana, Türkiye). The authors gratefully acknowledge Bekirhan Dağlı, partner at ITouch Systems, for infrastructure support and resource allocation.
